title: N — Exp 9: internal temperature sensor (ADC1 SS3 IRQ)
summary: ADC1 sample sequencer 3 samples the internal temperature sensor every 100 ms; ADC1SS3_Handler converts the code with the data-sheet formula. Green below 30 °C, blue 30–40 °C, red above.
expected: Select U1 (the MCU) and change the die temperature: the LED follows the converted reading
